prompt: Patrol the apartment and take photos of the windows

task.prompt: Patrol the apartment and take photos of the windows

design.summary: A light 2-wheel patroller with a wide camera that snaps both windows.

reasons.chassis-2wd-m: A small round base turns in place and fits the narrow doorway easily.
reasons.pi4b-4gb: Runs the camera and driving code at the lower price.
reasons.md-tb6612: A cheap dual driver is all two wheels need.
reasons.cam-pi3-wide: The 120 degree lens gets a whole window in one shot.
reasons.us-rcwl1601: Spots walls and furniture so the robot stops in time.
reasons.bat-nimh-2200: Enough charge for a full lap of the apartment.
reasons.reg-5v-3a: Gives the Pi a steady 5V 3A from the battery.
